'''''Triplachne''''' is a [[genus]] of seaside plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]], native to shorelines in the [[Mediterranean]] region from the [[Canary Islands]] to [[Turkey]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/13609523#page/249/mode/1up Link, Johann Heinrich Friedrich. 1833.  Hortus Regius Botanicus Berolinensis 2: 241-242] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/gen00658.htm Grassbase - The World Online Grass Flora]</ref><ref>[http://delta-intkey.com/grass/www/triplach.htm Grass Genera of the World by L. Watson and M. J. Dallwitz ] detailed description in English</ref> The only known species is '''''Triplachne nitens''''', called '''shining grass.'''<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=triplachne+nitens Altervista Flora Italiana, Codino lucido, Shining Grass,  ''Triplachne nitens'' (Guss.) Link ]</ref> It is native to [[Spain]] (incl [[Canary Islands|Canary]] + [[Balearic Islands|Balearic Is]]), [[Portugal]] (incl [[Madeira]]), [[Sicily]], [[Greece]] (incl [[Crete]]), [[Algeria]], [[Morocco]], [[Libya]], [[Tunisia]], [[Egypt]] (incl [[Sinai Peninsula|Sinai]]), [[Turkey]], [[Cyprus]], [[Palestine]], [[Israel]].<ref name=h/>
